documents.description: Turn instance self-update from a passive banner into a real product. ALL SIX WAVES SHIPPED. W1 Update-now Studio bar (#1195). W2 curated release notes (#1197). W3 release-curation agent (#1199). W4 fleet autoupdate — serial cohort-of-1 rollout worker with a 20-min settle gate + auto-pause containment (#1230). W5 from pipeline to product (#2227): canary-gated fleet (channel column, staging-green gate that fails open with no staging box and closes the day one lands), fleet-wide operator kill switch, operator update panel in the cloud console (per-instance truth + pin/pause/halt), bp cloud CLI update+policy truth with autoupdate/rollout verbs, and the curator's daily plain-text digest to platform admins. W6 rollback becomes real end-to-end (#2514): per-slot sha stamps + --rollback/--rollback-preflight modes in deploy/instance-deploy.sh (flip+reset, blocking own-port health gate, fail-closed exit 24), instance POST /v1/admin/rollback (sync preflight, typed 409s, shared single-flight with self-update), CP relay POST /v1/barkparks/:id/rollback with the atomic pinned_release write before the 202 (the rollout worker can never silently undo an operator), console Rollback button with typed conflict copy, and bp cloud rollback <instance>. The Checker/Runner/controller engine predates the epic; these waves added the surface + automation. Bless policy RATIFIED: agent-proposes / human-publishes by default; autonomous tag-on-green only once the staging gate is live. Fleet defaults to opt-OUT, cohort-of-1, with per-instance pause/pin. Run evidence at 703c5406: cloud Elixir 44/0 (router_autoupdate 15, router_rollback 12, autoupdate_rollout_worker 11, daily_digest_worker 6) + registry_autoupdate 24/0; api Elixir 27/0 (runner 10, self_update_controller 17); Go 1060 PASS/0 FAIL; offline deploy harness 99/99; cp-deploy harness 7/7; console SPA suite 388/388. PATH LAW: the rollout worker test lives at cloud/test/barkpark_cloud/autoupdate_rollout_worker_test.exs — NO workers/ segment (only daily_digest_worker_test.exs lives under workers/). Design paper: self-update-from-nag-to-product (rev 2). CLOSED 2026-07-11. Two deliberately-open remainders: isu-backlog-rollback-live-smoke (D26 recipe), isu-backlog-operator-principal (kill-switch reachability). Charter: .claude/workflows/bp-self-update-w5-charter.md.
